settings.title: We Compared 10 Pumpkin Seed Hair Serums for Thinning Hair. Here’s the Truth.
settings.dek: Pumpkin seed is on every label. In most of them, it isn’t what’s doing the work. One actually built a formula for women’s hair loss.
settings.byline: By the Elaren Hair Journal team · 5 min read
settings.image_alt: Elaren Pumpkin Seed Oil Serum with daisies

settings.text:
Your hair is thinning. Slowly, then fast. You’ve tried biotin, rosemary oil, expensive serums. Nothing worked.

Here’s the real reason. For many women, thinning is hormonal. A hormone called DHT slowly shrinks the follicles along your part and crown.

Pumpkin seed oil can help block it, but only if the formula is right.

We compared 10 of the most popular pumpkin seed hair serums. Here’s what we found.

settings.label: Key insights
settings.text: Most brands treat pumpkin seed as a supporting ingredient and still put it on the front of the bottle. The formula is what actually matters.

settings.eyebrow: What makes a hair serum work
settings.title: Three Things Separate What Works From What Doesn’t
The Formula
settings.text: Pumpkin seed oil works on DHT. Caffeine wakes up tired follicles. You need both.

settings.title: The Base
settings.text: Pumpkin seed oil should be the base of the serum, not an extract listed somewhere after the water.

settings.title: Extraction
settings.text: Cold-pressed oil keeps the plant sterols that block DHT. Heat and solvents strip them out.

settings.text:
This is the one women keep coming back to. It’s rated 4.77 out of 5 by verified buyers, and the reviews say the same things again and again: less shedding, a healthier scalp, and no greasy feeling.

It combines pumpkin seed oil with a Caffeine Complex. Pumpkin seed oil’s sterols help block the enzyme that makes DHT. Caffeine helps keep follicles in their growth phase. A couple of others pair pumpkin seed with caffeine too, but with water first on the label and pumpkin seed as a minor ingredient.

The oil is cold-pressed. That keeps its sterols, zinc and vitamin E intact. Several serums on this list use pumpkin seed extract instead, or list the oil far down the label. Cheaper, weaker, and you’d never know from the front of the bottle.

The research is on women. In a 3-month trial of 60 women with female pattern hair loss, pumpkin seed oil on the scalp reduced fine, thinning hairs and increased regrowing hairs (Ibrahim et al., 2021). In the lab, caffeine lengthened the growth phase of hair follicles from women’s scalps (Fischer et al., 2014).

Built for women. Not men. Not general hair care. The formula was designed around the hormonal reason women lose hair, and it’s light enough to use every night on any texture. That’s the whole difference.
settings.verdict: The only serum on this list that pairs cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil with caffeine in a nightly leave-in made for women. If your hair is thinning, start here.

settings.title: Ranks 2 to 10: The Rest of the Field

settings.name: rhute Triple Density Complex
settings.subtitle: Dermatologist-developed pre-wash oil
settings.text: The closest formula on this list. Developed by dermatologist Dr Aamna Adel, it lists pumpkin seed oil first, alongside black seed oil, saw palmetto, beta-sitosterol and ceramides. The catch is how you use it: it’s a pre-wash oil you rinse out, two to three times a week, so it only sits on your scalp for a short while. It also contains phenyl trimethicone, which is a silicone, plus fragrance. Its claims come from a 4-week consumer study of 34 women. It’s £35 from a UK brand, and it’s currently sold out with a waitlist.
settings.pros:
Pumpkin seed oil is the first ingredient
Adds black seed oil, saw palmetto and beta-sitosterol
Developed by a dermatologist
settings.cons:
Rinses off, so it only sits on the scalp briefly
Used 2 to 3 times a week, not nightly
Contains a silicone and added fragrance
Results come from a short 4-week study
Currently sold out, with a waitlist
settings.verdict: Strong ingredients, held back by a rinse-off format.

settings.name: MONPURE Follicle Boost Hair Density Serum
settings.subtitle: Premium nightly leave-in, 50 ml
settings.text: The luxury pick, with a Good Housekeeping best-serum award to its name. It’s a nightly leave-in that pairs pumpkin seed extract with vitamin A and lactic acid, it’s silicone-free, and it’s sold as pregnancy-safe. But water leads the label, pumpkin sits 10th, and it’s an extract rather than the oil. At $113 list price ($96.05 on the US site today, £83 in the UK) for 50 ml, it’s the most expensive bottle on this list.
settings.placeholder: MONPURE Follicle Boost Hair Density Serum
settings.pros:

settings.cons:

Pumpkin seed is an extract, 10th on the label

settings.verdict: Beautifully made, but you pay luxury prices for a little pumpkin.

settings.name: Hair Thickness Maximizer Pumpkin Seed Oil
settings.subtitle: 100% organic cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil
settings.text: The purist’s choice: nothing but organic, cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil. It’s unscented, preservative-free and affordable at $17.95 for 2 oz ($14.95 for 1 oz). But a single oil is only half the formula. There’s nothing alongside it to support the growth phase, it’s sold to men and women alike, and the directions say to use it two to four times a week rather than every night.
settings.placeholder: Hair Thickness Maximizer Pumpkin Seed Oil

settings.verdict: The right oil, on its own. Half the formula.

settings.name: IGK SPONSORED Hair Density Scalp Treatment
settings.subtitle: Daily spray with biotin and peptides
settings.text: A salon-brand favourite stocked at Sephora and Ulta, built around biotin and peptides. IGK cites a clinician-measured 37% reduction in the look of sparseness at 12 weeks, which is more evidence than most. But the label starts with water, then denatured alcohol, which can dry out the scalp. Pumpkin seed oil sits seventh, and there’s added fragrance. It’s $45 (currently $38.25) for 2.1 oz.

Rosemary, castor and pumpkin seed oil play supporting roles, and water is the first ingredient. At $19.99 for 3 fl oz ($13.99 at Ulta right now) it’s easy to try, but pumpkin seed oil isn’t what this formula is built on.

For $15.99 you get 1.69 fl oz.

It’s a rosemary and pumpkin seed oil blend for men and women, silicone-free, and pitched as a pre-wash, an overnight mask or a leave-in. It’s a general hair oil rather than a formula for women’s thinning, and the Amazon listing also includes castor oil, so check which version you’re buying.

It’s sold to men and women, and the copy centres on receding hairlines and bald spots, which isn’t how thinning usually shows up for women. It’s applied nightly with a derma roller upsell, it’s shown at $35.95 as 50% off $71.95, and the page lists key ingredients but no full ingredient list.

settings.title: After Comparing All 10: Here’s Where We’d Spend Our Money
settings.text:
If you’ve already tried a hair serum and it didn’t work, that’s not the idea failing you. It’s the formula. Most of what’s on this list treats pumpkin seed as a supporting ingredient behind water, alcohol or batana, sells the oil on its own, or rinses off before it has time to work.

Pumpkin seed oil is the right ingredient. It just needs to be cold-pressed, used as the base of the formula and paired with caffeine, in a serum light enough to use every night.

Elaren is the only serum on this list built around that. Everything else is a general hair oil, a serum where pumpkin seed plays a supporting role, or missing something critical.

If thinning hair is what you’re trying to fix, this is where we’d start.

settings.title: Pumpkin seed phytosterols
settings.text: Beta-sitosterol and delta-7-sterine, the plant sterols in pumpkin seed oil, help inhibit 5-alpha-reductase so less testosterone becomes follicle-shrinking DHT.

settings.title: Caffeine Complex
settings.text: Counteracts DHT’s effect on the follicle and helps extend the growth phase, so more of your hairs are growing and fewer are shedding.

settings.title: Omega-3, 6 & 9 fatty acids
settings.text: Linoleic, oleic and alpha-linolenic acids nourish the follicle, condition the scalp and reduce the dryness that leads to breakage.

settings.title: Zinc & magnesium
settings.text: Minerals naturally present in pumpkin seed oil that support keratin production and healthy follicle cycling.

settings.title: Vitamin E (tocopherols)
settings.text: A powerful antioxidant that neutralises the oxidative stress linked to premature follicle ageing and thinning.

settings.title: Carotenoids
settings.text: The pigments that give pumpkin seed oil its deep green-gold colour are anti-inflammatory, soothing the itchy, irritated scalp that so often comes with hair loss.
